Name: SP_EFFECT_VFX_PARAM_ST
Description: Visual and sound effects of an SpEffect: SFX and sounds, camouflage, armour transformation, material changes and weapon enchant trails. Used through the SpEffectParam VFX IDs; every VFX row of every active SpEffect is re-evaluated each frame.

Fields.Name: Midst SFX ID
Fields.Description: SFX that plays for as long as the effect is active, from the Midst Dummy Poly ID. For a weapon enchant (Effect Type 1/2) this is the enchant trail SFX drawn between the enchant dummy polys. -1: none. Several SpEffects using the same VFX row share one instance.

Fields.Name: Midst SE ID
Fields.Description: Sound (s-type) that plays while the effect is active, from the Midst Dummy Poly ID. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Start SFX ID
Fields.Description: One-shot SFX played when this VFX first appears on the character, from the Start Dummy Poly ID. Not replayed while the VFX is already showing. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Start SE ID
Fields.Description: One-shot sound (s-type) played when this VFX first appears, from the Start Dummy Poly ID. -1: none.

Fields.Name: End SFX ID
Fields.Description: One-shot SFX played when this VFX ends, from the End Dummy Poly ID. -1: none.

Fields.Name: End SE ID
Fields.Description: One-shot sound (s-type) played when this VFX ends, from the End Dummy Poly ID. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Camouflage - Start Distance
Fields.Description: Distance (m) between the character and the local player beyond which the character fades out. With End Distance it forms a hysteresis: once camouflaged, the character stays faded until the player comes closer than End Distance.

Fields.Name: Camouflage - End Distance
Fields.Description: Distance (m) to the local player below which a camouflaged character fades back in. Set it lower than the Start Distance.

Fields.Name: Transform - Protector ID
Fields.Description: Player characters only: shows this armour piece instead of the equipped one while the effect is active. By default it replaces the head piece; Is Full Body Transformation and Is Transformation for Arms pick the other override slots. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Midst Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly the Midst SFX and SE play from. The SFX plays on every dummy poly with this ID and does not play if the model has none. -1: the character's root.

Fields.Name: Start Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly the Start SFX and SE play from (every dummy poly with this ID). -1: the character's root.

Fields.Name: End Dummy Poly ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly the End SFX and SE play from (every dummy poly with this ID). -1: the character's root.

Fields.Name: Effect Type
Fields.Description: What the VFX applies to. 0: the character (SFX, sounds, decals). 1: right-hand weapon enchant. 2: left-hand weapon enchant. Weapon enchants work on player characters only, use the enchant dummy polys, and are hidden during Mimic's Veil. The other fields (camouflage, transformation, material, wetness) apply for every type.

Fields.Name: Weapon Enchant - Material Type
Fields.Description: Weapon enchants (Effect Type 1/2): built-in material effect (the blade glow) put on the enchanted weapon. 0: none. Shields and torches use a different set of material effects for the same value.

Fields.Name: Play Category
Fields.Description: Exclusive group for VFX that should not stack. 0: always plays. 1–8: of all active VFX in the same category, only the one with the lowest Play Priority plays (up to 4 with the same priority).

Fields.Name: Play Priority
Fields.Description: Priority within the Play Category; the lowest value plays. For camouflage, the camouflage VFX with the lowest value sets the distances, alpha and fade rates.

Fields.Name: Use SFX Size Variants
Fields.Description: If set, the six SFX and SE IDs are offset by the character's NpcParam SFX Size: +0 normal, +1 medium, +2 large. The variant IDs must exist.

Fields.Name: Soul Effect Exists
Fields.Description: Is there an effect for the soul body?

Fields.Name: Camouflage - Hide SFX
Fields.Description: If set, this VFX's SFX is hidden while the character is camouflaged.

Fields.Name: Camouflage - Enable
Fields.Description: Makes the character fade out by distance to the local player (see the camouflage distances, alpha and fade rates). Without Invisible for Friend, only hostile characters see the fade.

Fields.Name: Camouflage - Invisible for Friend
Fields.Description: If set, the camouflage also applies when the local player is friendly to the character; otherwise friendly viewers see the character normally.

Fields.Name: Camouflage - Hide Foot Effect
Fields.Description: If set, the character's foot effects are turned off while the camouflage is active.

Fields.Name: Camouflage - Translucent Appearance
Fields.Description: If set, the camouflage ignores Min Alpha: the character fades to 20% when camouflaged and stays at 80% when the player is close.

Fields.Name: Is Full Body Transformation
Fields.Description: If set, the Transform - Protector ID is used as a full-body appearance override instead of the head override.

Fields.Name: Is Invisible Weapon
Fields.Description: Weapon enchants: hides the enchanted weapon's model once the enchant has faded in.

Fields.Name: Is Silent
Fields.Description: If set, the character is marked silent while the effect is active (works with or without camouflage).

Fields.Name: Is Midst SFX Full Body
Fields.Description: Do you use whole body Damipoli for equipping SFX during effect? Play SFX from torso: 190, head: 191, hands: 192, legs: 193 at 1

Fields.Name: Is Start SFX Full Body
Fields.Description: Do you use the whole body Damipoli for equipping SFX during activation? Play SFX from torso: 190, head: 191, hands: 192, legs: 193 at 1

Fields.Name: Is End SFX Full Body
Fields.Description: Do you use the whole body Damipoli for equipping SFX at the time of release? Play SFX from torso: 190, head: 191, hands: 192, legs: 193 at 1

Fields.Name: Is Visible on Dead Character
Fields.Description: If set, the VFX keeps playing on a dead character; otherwise the VFX is not applied while the character is dead.

Fields.Name: Use Enchant SFX Size to Offset SFX ID
Fields.Description: Weapon enchants: adds the weapon's EquipParamWeapon Enchant SFX Size to the Midst SFX ID, so one row can pick a trail sized for each weapon.

Fields.Name: Decal ID [0]
Fields.Description: Decal placed when the effect starts (Effect Type 0). -1: none.

Fields.Name: Decal ID [1]
Fields.Description: Second decal placed when the effect starts (Effect Type 0). -1: none.

Fields.Name: Foot Effect Priority
Fields.Description: Foot effect offset priority (lower is higher)

Fields.Name: Foot Effect Offset
Fields.Description: Amount offset to foot effect ID when this special effect is applied

Fields.Name: Trace SFX ID Offset Type
Fields.Description: Changes the weapon swing trail SFX. 0: no change; n (1–28): the trail SFX ID is offset by 9000 + 1000 × n (1 → +10000, 28 → +37000). Effect Type 0 changes both weapons; a weapon enchant changes only that hand.

Fields.Name: Force Deceased Type
Fields.Description: Forced living/dead display type, set on the character while the effect is active. 0: no change.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX Start - Dummy Poly ID [0]
Fields.Description: Damipoli ID generated at the base of enchantment

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX End - Dummy Poly ID [0]
Fields.Description: Weapon enchants: weapon dummy poly where enchant trail 1 ends. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX Start - Dummy Poly ID [1]
Fields.Description: Weapon enchants: start dummy poly of enchant trail 2. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX End - Dummy Poly ID [1]
Fields.Description: Weapon enchants: end dummy poly of enchant trail 2. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX Start - Dummy Poly ID [2]
Fields.Description: Weapon enchants: start dummy poly of enchant trail 3. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX End - Dummy Poly ID [2]
Fields.Description: Weapon enchants: end dummy poly of enchant trail 3. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX Start - Dummy Poly ID [3]
Fields.Description: Weapon enchants: start dummy poly of enchant trail 4. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX End - Dummy Poly ID [3]
Fields.Description: Weapon enchants: end dummy poly of enchant trail 4. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX Start - Dummy Poly ID [4]
Fields.Description: Weapon enchants: start dummy poly of enchant trail 5. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX End - Dummy Poly ID [4]
Fields.Description: Weapon enchants: end dummy poly of enchant trail 5. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX Start - Dummy Poly ID [5]
Fields.Description: Weapon enchants: start dummy poly of enchant trail 6. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX End - Dummy Poly ID [5]
Fields.Description: Weapon enchants: end dummy poly of enchant trail 6. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX Start - Dummy Poly ID [6]
Fields.Description: Weapon enchants: start dummy poly of enchant trail 7. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX End - Dummy Poly ID [6]
Fields.Description: Weapon enchants: end dummy poly of enchant trail 7. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX Start - Dummy Poly ID [7]
Fields.Description: Weapon enchants: start dummy poly of enchant trail 8. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Enchant SFX End - Dummy Poly ID [7]
Fields.Description: Weapon enchants: end dummy poly of enchant trail 8. -1: none.

Fields.Name: SFX ID Offset Type
Fields.Description: Where the Start, Midst and End SFX IDs come from. 0: this row. 2: Mimic's Veil: the SFX of the current disguise from MapMimicryEstablishmentParam (nothing plays if there is none); the sounds still come from this row.

Fields.Name: Phantom Param Overwrite Type
Fields.Description: Overrides the character's phantom look while the effect is active. 0: no change. 1: no phantom param. 2: uses the Phantom Param Overwrite ID. Re-evaluated every frame, so it ends with the effect.

Fields.Name: Camouflage - Min Alpha
Fields.Description: Opacity (%) the character fades to while camouflaged. 0: fully invisible. Ignored with Translucent Appearance.

Fields.Name: Wet Aspect Type
Fields.Description: Wetness look put on the character when the effect applies. 0: none. Types 1–3, 5, 6 and 19 follow the effect's duration; the other types apply a fixed wetness.

Fields.Name: Phantom Param Overwrite ID
Fields.Description: PhantomParam row used when Phantom Param Overwrite Type is 2.

Fields.Name: Material Param ID
Fields.Description: Material parameter animated on the character's materials while the effect is active. 0–99: built-in parameters; 100 and up: a MaterialExParam row. -1: none. Up to 4 at once per character.

Fields.Name: Material Param - Start Value
Fields.Description: Value of the material parameter when the effect starts.

Fields.Name: Material Param - End Value
Fields.Description: Value the material parameter reaches after the fade time.

Fields.Name: Material Param - Fade Time
Fields.Description: Seconds to go from the start value to the end value.

Fields.Name: Foot Decal Material Offset Overwrite ID
Fields.Description: Override for the floor-material offset of the character's footprint decals, set while the effect is active. -1: no override.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail: 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Overlay Material Param ID
Fields.Description: Overlay material (OverlayMaterialParam ID) put on the character while the effect is active; up to four can be active at once. -1: none.
